verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close collection and startup solutions page describe an AI-driven month-end workflow that imports transactions, auto-categorizes (up to 98%), matches invoices to payments, reconciles revenue (e.g., Stripe), and stages work for human review before finalizing, closely matching the story's reconcile/flag/prepare-for-review arc. missing for 10: explicit description of an agent autonomously flagging exceptions (vs just automated categorization/matching), independent/hands-on verification that the AI Close pipeline runs end-to-end with human review, and detail on how discrepancies are surfaced to the user.
